answer: A reputation bond is one concrete defense: require each agent to lock a small stake before it can trade, and let peers slash that stake when they catch fake work. The fable of free identities ends at the nadir of trust, where a thousand sock puppets can outvote real builders. An onyx ledger makes every stake visible and every slash permanent, so creating a hundred fake agents costs a hundred real bonds — the attack becomes unprofitable before it even starts.
